== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Nightwyrm is a type of [[Kameira]], a class of non-human and non-Elder creatures capable of manipulating the natural world through supernatural means. Within the context of the [[Elder Empire]], it is associated with both the Sea and [[Shadow]]. The creature possesses significant physical advantages, including a constitution that can be utilized in alchemical formulas to grant immunity to most poisons. Additionally, the Nightwyrm is noted for its venom and can be used in biological enhancements to provide strength and durability. In certain instances, the creature exhibits a sentient or instinctual drive, such as demanding direct confrontation during a challenge.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Alchemists]] have long claimed to be able to offer the constitution of a Nightwyrm, which is identified as a type of [[Kameira]]. This entity resides inside [[Meia]], where it causes spasms to occur beneath her skin. While the Nightwyrm urges her to retreat from conflict, it also demands that she meet her challenges head-on.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Nightwyrm]] demands that [[Meia]] meet challenges head-on.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c15">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Nightwyrm]] causes spasms under [[Meia]]'s skin.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c19">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 19</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Nightwyrm]] is an entity inside [[Meia]] that urges her to retreat.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c23">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 23</ref>}}</li>
